section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section summarizes the paper's findings, stating that both loneliness and gratitude are important for subjective well-being, with gratitude predicting positive affect and different types of loneliness predicting negative affect and life satisfaction. It also outlines theoretical and practical contributions, and discusses limitations related to the demographic characteristics of the convenience sample (e.g., online research, lack of diverse education/socio-economic backgrounds) while suggesting improvements for future research.
